cases.sentence: Они увели всех мужчин, женщин, детей и ___, которых Невузарадан, начальник царской охраны, оставил с Гедалией, сыном Ахикама, внуком Шафана, и пророка Иеремию с Барухом, сыном Нирии.
cases.explain: «царских дочерей» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: the men, and the women, and the children, and the king’s daughters, and every person who Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had left with Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan; and Jeremiah the prophet, and Baruch the son of Neriah;

cases.sentence: Царь Вавилона подожжет храмы ___; он сожжет их храмы и пленит их богов.
cases.explain: «египетских богов» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: I will kindle a fire in the houses of the gods of Egypt. He will burn them, and carry them away captive. He will array himself with the land of Egypt, as a shepherd puts on his garment; and he will go out from there in peace.

cases.sentence: Он сокрушит ___ в храме солнца , что в земле Египта, и сожжет храмы египетских богов».
cases.explain: «каменные столбы» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: He will also break the pillars of Beth Shemesh, that is in the land of Egypt; and he will burn the houses of the gods of Egypt with fire.’ ”
